nodes.label: Multi-channel customer messaging over chat channels
Message channel type taxonomy (in_app/sms/whatsapp/email)
Unknown-number inbound SMS triage and later customer linking
Twilio SMS delivery-status audit trail
Per-tenant 10DLC brand and campaign registration state
Rationale: extend the existing chat tables instead of building a parallel SMS store
Per-tenant monthly pricing tier threshold (30 or 31 days)
Rationale: the tier threshold column doubles as the pro-rata divisor for monthly rates
Custom booking/portal domain to tenant resolution
Gotcha: a custom domain row is inert until the domain is also added in Vercel and DNS repointed
Rationale: partial indexes exist because middleware resolves the domain on every request
Security-deposit pre-authorisation hold lifecycle on rentals
Rationale: holds are placed at key giving, released at key receiving, and auto-refreshed for long rentals
Tesla Supercharger session billing back to the renter
Tenant-level Tesla Fleet API OAuth token store with test/live mode
Ledger entry category taxonomy (the billable-line vocabulary)
Rationale: per-verb RLS policies replace an earlier blanket FOR ALL policy on supercharger charges
Scheduled auto-send of lockbox codes before rental start
Lockbox code send audit log (scheduled/sent/resent/rescheduled/failed)
Rationale: NULL offset means manual-only send, 0 means exactly at start time
Rescheduling a rental resets its lockbox send state
Rationale: clearing lockbox_sent_at is how the cron is made to re-evaluate send time
Automated vehicle-return reminders with per-tenant lead time
Turnaround buffer keeping a vehicle unavailable after a rental ends
Buffer-time ceiling raised from 8 hours to 72 hours
Rental approval timestamp used as the lockbox auto-send anchor
In-portal Twilio voice calling (TwiML app + API key per tenant)
Call log records for inbound and outbound voice calls
'voice' added to the message channel taxonomy on both chat tables
Rationale: call_logs INSERT/UPDATE policies are WITH CHECK (false) so only service_role edge functions may write
Tenant-isolated blog CMS with SEO fields and draft/published workflow
Blog post version snapshots taken on each publish
Anonymous read access for the public booking site (published posts only)
Gotcha: blog RLS gives every authenticated user USING(true); tenant isolation is enforced only in the app layer, matching cms_pages
Blog page added to the per-tenant CMS page seed function plus a backfill for existing tenants
Per-minute pg_cron trigger for lockbox auto-send
Rationale: the edge function is idempotent and verify_jwt=false, so the cron posts with no auth header
15-minute pg_cron trigger for return reminders
Vehicle double-booking prevention at write time
Rationale: a trigger rather than an exclusion constraint, so pre-existing overlapping rows are not invalidated
Terminal rental statuses (Cancelled/Rejected/Closed) are exempt from the overlap check
Pay-as-you-go rental billing (open-ended rentals accrued daily)
Tenant-level PAYG defaults with per-rental overrides
Daily accrual idempotency record preventing double-posted charges
PAYG payment-reminder send audit log
PAYG runaway safety caps (max reminders, max open duration with one-shot admin alert)
Pro-rated partial final day when an admin finalises a PAYG rental mid-cycle
Rationale: PAYG reuses the existing Rental/Tax/Service Fee ledger categories so no CHECK constraint change is needed
Pivot from managed Twilio subaccounts to tenant-owned (BYO) Twilio credentials
Rationale: a destructive rename-and-drop was acceptable because no production tenant was on a subaccount yet
10DLC brand/campaign registration becomes the tenant's own responsibility (state no longer tracked)
15-minute pg_cron trigger for PAYG daily accrual
Rationale: cron resolves the project URL from current_setting at runtime instead of hardcoding it
Hourly pg_cron trigger for PAYG payment reminders
Rationale: fire hourly and let the function decide per-rental, so any tenant timezone is supported
A chat channel is auto-provisioned for every new customer
Rationale: channels were created lazily by the booking customer portal, so operators could not message customers who never opened chat
One-shot backfill of chat channels for pre-existing customers
Lazy chat-channel creation in the booking customer portal (superseded by the DB trigger)
Call forwarding to staff personal numbers
Voicemail capture with listened/listened-by tracking
Private 'voicemails' storage bucket for recording audio
Gotcha: voicemail storage policies key on bucket_id alone, with no tenant scoping in the object path check
Call recording with AI transcript, summary and extracted action items
Atomic reminder-counter RPC replacing a racy read-then-write update
PAYG cron jobs re-scheduled to carry a service_role bearer token
Rationale: unauthenticated cron posts left the PAYG endpoints callable by anyone who knew the project URL
Unique partial index deduping PAYG charge ledger entries by reference
Active agreement template scoped per (tenant, category) rather than per tenant
PAYG gets its own agreement template category alongside standard and extension
